name: Reservation
description: A booking of a resource's time that waits for its payment (D103): a Workflow on status with fixed states (draft, held, booked, expired, cancelled); Holds, which takes the resource's time for the booking's interval as it enters held, commits it as it is booked and lets it go as it expires or is cancelled; Payments, which owes the booking's amount in its currency, holds booked until it is paid, and voids what is authorized when the booking expires or is cancelled; and a Timers deadline that expires a booking fifteen minutes after it enters held. The resource is a to-one relation of the table to a table that implements Calendar, the supply of its time, whose hours and capacity are the resource's own.

resource.description: The to-one relation of the table to the resource whose time a booking holds: a table that implements Calendar.

interval.description: The booking's time: the own date-time fields it starts and ends at.

start.description: The own date-time field the booking starts at.

end.description: The own date-time field the booking ends at.

amount.description: The own integer field that holds what a booking owes, in the currency's minor units.

currency.description: The currency of the amount: an ISO 4217 code.
